metadata.description: Mods for Claude Code: a claude-hud port, a Tailscale band, a Hitokoto band and spinner animations

plugins.name: hud
plugins.description: claude-hud 0.10.0 as a mod: model, project, git, context, usage, tools, agents and todos, below or above the prompt, plus alerts, budget, history, a task summary, a detail pane and switchable themes

plugins.name: ts-band
plugins.description: Tailscale nodes' state in a band above the prompt

plugins.name: hitokoto
plugins.description: A line from Hitokoto (一言) in a band above the prompt, refreshed on a timer, per session, per prompt or once a day

plugins.name: spinner
plugins.description: Animations and a companion pet while the model works: a mascot beside the spinner, a scene above the prompt (a shoot-em-up, Clawd, pixel homages and more), a finale and a pet that levels up, in fourteen themes
